/data-purchase.description: Purchase internet data package - automatically debits user balance and creates transaction

body.recipient: string (required) - Phone number to receive data (10 digits starting with 0)

Missing networkKey.error: networkKey is required (YELLO, MTN_PRO, AT_PREMIUM, TELECEL, AT_BIGTIME)

Invalid networkKey.error: Invalid networkKey. Must be one of: YELLO, MTN_PRO, AT_PREMIUM, TELECEL, AT_BIGTIME

Invalid recipient.error: Recipient must be a valid 10-digit phone number starting with 0

Invalid capacity.error: Capacity must be a positive number

403.description: API key not linked to user account

example.error: API key is not linked to a user account. Please contact support.

Network not found.error: Network YELLO not found or not active

Bundle not found.error: No bundle found for 10GB on MTN. Available sizes: 1GB, 2GB, 5GB

/external/order-status.description: Check order status by reference or order number
/external/order-status.note: Requires valid API key authentication. Returns detailed order information including status, network, phone number, and transaction details. Only GET method is supported.

get.description: Get order status using query parameters

data.statusDescription: Order completed successfully - data bundle delivered

example.message: Either 'reference' or 'orderNumber' query parameter is required
Please provide your API key in the X-API-Key header or Authorization header

example.error: Order not found with reference: ORDER_abc123

INITIATED.details: Order has been created and is in the initial stage of processing

PENDING.details: Order has been created and is awaiting processing

PROCESSING.description: Order sent to network provider, awaiting completion
PROCESSING.details: Order has been sent to the network provider and is being processed

SUCCESSFUL.description: Order completed successfully - data bundle delivered
SUCCESSFUL.details: Data bundle has been successfully delivered to the recipient

FAILED.description: Order failed - please contact support or try again
FAILED.details: Order processing failed, may require manual intervention

CANCELLED.details: Order was cancelled by user or admin

automatic.details: Orders are processed automatically through the network provider's API

manual.details: Orders that failed automatic processing are handled manually by administrators

failed.details: Orders that encountered errors during processing

authentication: Always include your API key in the X-API-Key header
Keep your API key secure and never expose it in client-side code
Rotate your API key periodically for security
requests: Use GET requests for order status checks (better performance and caching)
Implement proper error handling for all API responses
Use appropriate HTTP status codes for error handling
rateLimiting: Implement reasonable polling intervals (30-60 seconds for order status)
Don't overwhelm the API with rapid requests
Consider implementing exponential backoff for failed requests
security: Use HTTPS for all API calls
Validate all input data before sending to the API
Implement proper logging for debugging and monitoring
